subject.title: fix(ui): prevent collapsed sidebar overlap in control UI

question: Should maintainers salvage this PR by rebasing and scoping the 96px rail change against the current Control UI layout, or replace it with a fresh proof-backed fix for the linked Safari issue?
rationale: The branch is an external stale bug-fix PR that changes a responsive layout token, lacks after-fix Safari proof, and is behind a major Control UI refactor, so automation cannot choose the permanent responsive behavior or supply contributor proof.

options.title: Rebase and scope the fix
options.body: Keep the useful desktop Safari mitigation, port it to current files, confine responsive impact, and require current regression coverage plus real browser proof.

options.title: Accept wider rail with proof
options.body: Allow the 96px rail as a deliberate responsive behavior change only if proof shows tablet and mobile drawer behavior remain usable.

options.title: Replace the branch
options.body: Close or pause this stale PR and ask for a narrow replacement if rebasing would discard most of the old branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase and scope the fix
recommendation.body: Keep the useful desktop Safari mitigation, port it to current files, confine responsive impact, and require current regression coverage plus real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main sidebar resizing and layout work makes this the clearest available routing owner for the responsive layout decision.
